title: Launch signal smoke testbed
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, execution-first notebook for running a smoke-style readiness test ahead of a small pilot release. The goal is to provide a reproducible sequence of checks that validate the launch signal plumbing: traffic shaping, routing fallbacks, KPI telemetry, and operator playbooks. This doc pairs a lightweight roadmap tracker with KPI snapshots and an actionable smoke checklist so owners can run the test in ~2 hours and capture the critical signals for go/no-go.

Scope and success criteria:
- Scope: focused pilot (first 1,000 daily active users) and the associated platform routes, model variants, and observability dashboards. Not a full-scale stress test.
- Success: all smoke checks green OR documented mitigations for the top-3 failure modes and an agreed rollback window.

Top objectives (why we run this):
1) Validate that routing policies (region/cost-tier/latency) apply correctly under a controlled traffic pattern.
2) Ensure KPI telemetry (latency p50/p95, token cost per request, error rate) surfaces within 5 minutes of event.
3) Confirm canary fallback: when primary model capacity is saturated, traffic shifts to fallback variant without >3x latency increase.
4) Verify runbook steps execute and on-call escalation completes within target times.

KPI snapshot (how we measure):
- Primary latency p50 target: <= 120ms (small model), p95 target: <= 400ms
- Embedded request token cost target: <= $0.004 per request (pilot config)
- Error rate target: request-level errors <= 0.5%
- Cold-start events: <= 2 during the 2-hour window
- Rollback time goal: <= 20 minutes from detection to traffic rollback
- Monitoring lag: alerts/timeseries visible in console < 5 minutes

KPI table (sample rows to collect during run — record values in column format when you run):
- KPI | Target | Baseline | Pilot run value | Notes
- latency.p50 | 120ms | 98ms | (fill in) | note region/variant
- latency.p95 | 400ms | 310ms | (fill in) | note spikes if any
- token_cost_per_request | $0.004 | $0.0036 | (fill in) | include quantization profile used
- error_rate | 0.5% | 0.1% | (fill in) | error class (timeout/quotas/5xx)
- fallback_switch_time | 30s | 12s | (fill in) | measured from signal to routing change

Planned sequence (checklist to run in order):
1) Pre-check (15 min): owners confirm baseline dashboards, manifests, canary policy and A/B weight controls are set. Document baseline values. Owners: Ava + Ravi.
2) Traffic ramp (20 min): synthetic traffic to 10 rps across two regions, verify telemetry arrives. Owner: SRE (Jonas).
3) Model variant switch test (15 min): intentionally reduce primary pool to trigger fallback, confirm traffic shifts and KPIs meet rollback thresholds. Owner: infra eng (Maya).
4) Cost and billing sample (10 min): sample token burn for 100 requests, estimate cost delta if using quantized variant. Owner: finance liaison (Ravi).
5) Runbook drill (20 min): trigger a simulated 5xx cascade, follow on-call runbook steps, escalate to on-call and confirm acknowledgement + remediation steps executed. Owner: product-ops (Ava).
6) Post-run capture (10 min): snapshot dashboards, export relevant logs, annotate anomalies in this doc, and create incident tickets if needed. Owner: all collaborators.

Roadmap tracker (mini):
- Week -2: finalize pilot config and owner roster (status: done)
- Week -1: deploy observability dashboards + baseline metrics (status: done)
- D-day (pilot smoke): run this smoke test (status: planned)
- D+1: triage and decision (status: planned)

Runbook / Playbook quick checks (explicit pass/fail):
- Alerting hooks wired to Slack channel #prod-alerts (pass/fail): (record)
- Pager rotation test (pass/fail): (record)
- Canary rollback script executes in < 20m (pass/fail): (record)
- Circuit breaker threshold triggers and isolates failing route (pass/fail): (record)

Risks and immediate mitigations observed in pilot context:
- Risk: delayed telemetry visibility (mitigation: increase sampling for control plane traces for 30 minutes)
- Risk: quantized model hallucination regression (mitigation: route flagged prompts to human review during pilot)
- Risk: burst capacity shortage in region B (mitigation: preallocate 10% burst capacity on Dedicated for pilot window)

Decisions to pre-approve for tester (reduce friction):
- If error_rate > 2% for 10 consecutive minutes -> auto rollback to previous stable route unless Product Ops explicitly overrides.
- If p95 latency > 800ms for > 5 minutes -> scale down pilot and open incident.

Action items (post-run deliverables):
- Capture CSV of the KPI table and attach to this doc (owner: Jonas, due: D+0)
- Create incident ticket for any performance failure and link here (owner: Ava, due: D+0)
- Draft short one-pager for execs summarizing go/no-go recommendation (owner: Maya, due: D+1)

Open questions (to resolve before next pilot run):
- Do we need to increase retention on token-level traces for 48 hours for deeper cost debugging? (open)
- Is finance comfortable with the $X upper bound on token burn during pilot? (open)

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally terse and tactical. If you are reading after the run, add timestamped notes under a new section called "post-run notes". Keep the original KPI snapshots intact.
- Reference: runbook snippet lives in Confluence (link above). Use JIRA-OPS-2142 for any follow-ups.

Appendix: quick command snippets and links:
- Synthetic traffic CLI: infra/tools/traffic-gen --profile pilot-10rps --region us-west1
- Export dashboard: Console -> Dashboards -> Launch Smoke -> Export CSV
- Canary rollback script: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/scripts/canary_rollback.sh

End of doc.
